blocks.html: Whether you’ve had a lifelong battle with your weight or you just want to lose a few stubborn pounds, the team at Victory Medical can help. Serving the community of Austin and the surrounding areas of Texas, the experts at Victory Medical are here to help you start and complete your weight loss journey.

Custom compounded appetite suppressants support your weight loss efforts by helping you feel full. Specific active ingredients are carefully chosen by the team at Victory Medical and prescribed to promote fat burning and keep your metabolism running.

The team at Victory Medical provide appetite suppressants that are specially compounded to contain only ingredients chosen for their effectiveness and safety profile. When appetite suppressants are compounded, it means they contain the optimal doses of each of the ingredients.

blocks.text: ACTIVE INGREDIENTS INCLUDED IN EACH COMPOUND

blocks.html: Chromium is an essential mineral your body uses to metabolize carbohydrates and fats. It promotes weight loss and appetite reduction. It may be especially beneficial if you crave carbohydrates.
Carnitine is naturally synthesized in your body, where it transports fats into cells so the fat can be burned for energy. As a result, it contributes to overall weight loss.

Theanine is a non-protein-forming amino acid found in green tea. In tea, theanine contributes to flavor and is the ingredient credited with promoting relaxation. It also helps inhibit the absorption of carbohydrates, lower blood levels of triglycerides, and suppress weight gain.

You need vitamin B-6 to metabolize the proteins used to synthesize carnitine and growth hormones that help burn fat. Vitamin B-6 further supports weight loss by converting glycogen to glucose, so you have energy without consuming more carbs. Vitamin B-6 also keeps your metabolism running by supporting thyroid function.

blocks.text: B-12 INJECTION: GET YOUR ENERGY BACK

blocks.html: If you’re overweight, your blood levels of vitamin B-12 could be low, which means your body may not produce enough energy. The team at Victory Medical can solve that problem with vitamin B-12 injections. If tests show you have a vitamin B-12 deficiency, injections get the vitamin quickly into your system, boosting your energy and helping you stick with your weight loss program.

Your liver is responsible for eliminating fat and toxins from your body. It can do its job better and stay healthier when it’s not burdened with fat buildup. In fact, too much fat in your liver may cause inflammation and damage that leads to scarring and cirrhosis, a condition called nonalcoholic steatohepatitis.

blocks.text: UNDERSTAND WHAT YOUR BODY NEEDS WITH AN INITIAL WEIGHT CONSULTATION WITH THE EXPERTS

blocks.html: To help you reach your weight loss goals, the team at Victory Medical needs to thoroughly understand your current health, as well as your past medical history, eating habits, and many other factors that impact your weight loss success. Your journey starts with an initial medical consultation to gather all the necessary health information.

It is possible to lose weight fast and to do it safely when you rely on the professional support and expertise of the team at Victory Medical. They offer natural hormone injections paired with a very-low-calorie diet, along with all the support you need to lose weight and keep it off for the long run.

blocks.text: WEIGHT LOSS COUNSELING FOR THE BODY & THE MIND

blocks.html: When it comes to weight loss, many people are prone to focus purely on the physical, but it is also the psychological that is important. This is especially critical when it comes to maintaining your weight goal. Weight loss surveillance and counseling are two of the best services available to help you lose weight. The team at Victory Medical offers weight loss surveillance and counseling because they know that people who track their progress and receive one-on-one support through counseling are more likely to reach their weight loss goal and maintain their healthy weight and lifestyle changes.
